facts.business: Vivo Bio Tech Limited is a Hyderabad-headquartered, full-service preclinical Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing discovery, development, in vivo and in vitro toxicology, genetic toxicology, DMPK/bioanalytical, ecotoxicology, and medical-device biocompatibility services under OECD GLP, AAALACi, and CDSCO-recognised standards.

capacity_or_capex.item: Four high-performance LC-MS/MS systems for bioanalytical capacity
Analytical and research infrastructure including HPLC, LC-MS/MS, flow cytometry and multimode reader platforms
Planned expansion of swine and non-human primate (NHP) facilities

guidance_or_targets.statement: Convert investments in people, technology, analytical capabilities and large-animal infrastructure into sustainable CRO revenue growth
Focus on higher-value GLP-compliant programmes, deeper relationships with pharmaceutical and multinational clients
Deepen client trust, improve project delivery, convert installed capacity into sustainable revenue and deploy capital selectively
guidance_or_targets.value: Consistent execution, higher utilisation, stronger cash generation, transparent governance
